1.0.1.changeLog: Updated to remain compatible with the latest Microsoft changes. No functional changes. Resolves the mismatch status.

1.0.2.changeLog: Microsoft added new default properties to Windows Update Ring policies: deadlineGracePeriodForFeatureUpdatesInDays and deadlineGracePeriodForQualityUpdatesInDays (null), postponeRebootUntilAfterDeadlineForFeatureUpdates and postponeRebootUntilAfterDeadlineForQualityUpdates (notConfigured). Added them so deployed policies no longer show a mismatch. Policy behavior is unchanged.
